about_the_game:
"RPG Soundtrack Collection - 8bit Edition" is a great pack of music that includes a total of 29 tracks, covering a wide range of situations, including battles, fields, towns, dungeons, and events!
Each track has both an orchestral (sold separately) and 8-bit version !
Choose the style that best represents your worldview! (Alternatively, both!)
All tracks are about 1 minute in length making them extremely easy to use to adapt into your game!

*This collection is the 8bit Edition.
